verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs confirm core elements: issuing founder stock/equity, IRS form completion and submission (which covers 83(b) elections), and a legal dashboard for post-incorporation paperwork, and community reviews confirm the process 'gets things done correctly' right after incorporation. However, IP assignment agreements are never explicitly named in the evidence, and no first-party page walks through the specific post-incorporation bundle (stock purchase + IP assignment + 83(b)) as a unified workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of IP assignment agreements, a dedicated walkthrough of the founder stock purchase + 83(b) bundle, and independent hands-on confirmation of 83(b) filing success.
